description: Copies the book, with a sealed manifest, into a new folder under /tmp/churn-koarh4tl/spr-books/exports, for an auditor or a counterparty to check with spr-verify. Give a short folder name, not a path. Returns the folder, the files and the result of checking the copy (verified, passed, failed). If the folder already holds an export it fails, unless overwrite is true. For a spreadsheet or reporting format, use export_xbrl_csv instead.

name.description: A folder name: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, such as audit-2026-10

overwrite.description: Replace an earlier export of that name

name: export_package
